qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High-cost potash and salt miner lacking defensible cost leadership or pricing power. Global fertilizer price-taker subject to volatile commodity swings; multi-cycle ROCE averages ~3% (far below 12% hurdle), spiking only during temporary supply shocks (2022). Constrained by environmental brine disposal limits in German operations.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing). German potash and salt producer with structurally high production costs and significant environmental brine disposal constraints. Commodity price-taker whose margins follow volatile spot potash prices, resulting in multi-cycle median ROIC well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Historical ROCE is structurally depressed: 1.9% in 2019, 0.0% in 2020, 3.2% in 2021, cyclically spiking to 25.7% in 2022 before fading to 11.2% in 2023 and ~3.2% in 2024. 5-year median ROIC is far below the 12% threshold. High fixed-cost underground mines in Germany face severe regulatory constraints over Werra river brine discharge.
